svg.title: CampusOS | Conceptual domain ER
svg.desc: CURRENT EXTENDED MODEL / 12 domain entities / Chen-inspired notation / Authentication is separated in the relational plate
svg.text: CURRENT EXTENDED MODEL / 12 domain entities / Chen-inspired notation / Authentication is separated in the relational plate
Underlined ellipse = primary key • Edge labels = min..max related rows per entity at that endpoint • Selected attributes shown; full schema in relational plate
Scope: academic9 + attendance + library_book + library_loan. Associative entities preserve assignment, enrollment and loan identities.
No ISA hierarchy: faculty is an independent entity; admin/student are account role values, not faculty/student subclasses.
Inspired by the supplied hospital report, page 2: entity rectangles, relationship diamonds, attribute ellipses, underlined keys; topology is CampusOS-specific.
